The existing actual divisor moving lemma presents every literal Picard class by a finite analytic divisor. Apply the native quotient-kernel isomorphism theorem to the two actual surjective maps with equal kernels. This avoids reconstructing global differential-coordinate charts or substituting the existing Gamma0 Picard equivalence.
